title: Commercial Video Production & Social Storytelling
description: Learn camera lighting, video shooting, Premiere Pro & DaVinci Resolve editing, color grading, and storytelling for YouTube & Reels.
capstoneDesc: Premiere & DaVinci Resolve Portfolio Reel for Agency Pitch

lessons.title: The 3-Act Commercial Scriptwriting Framework
overview: Structure 30-second and 60-second commercial spots that hook viewers emotionally and motivate brand action.
Draft treatment documents and two-column AV scripts for agency client approval.

takeaways.title: Hook-Problem-Resolution
takeaways.desc: Anchor viewer attention in the first 2.5 seconds with cognitive dissonance.

takeaways.title: Visual Beats
takeaways.desc: Write for the eyes first; dialogue should never explain what images can reveal.

lessons.title: Storyboarding & Cinematic Pre-visualization
overview: Translate written scripts into camera shot lists, lens selections, and lighting schematics.
Coordinate production call sheets, talent release forms, and location permits.

takeaways.title: Shot Variety
takeaways.desc: Ensure coverage with wide establishing, medium dialogue, and macro insert shots.

takeaways.title: Spatial Continuity
takeaways.desc: Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule across dialogue camera reversals.

lessons.title: 3-Point Commercial Lighting & Motivated Sources
overview: Shape light using key, fill, and hair lights with softboxes, grids, and negative fill flags.
Match color temperatures (Kelvin) between artificial practicals and daylight ambient.

takeaways.title: Contrast Ratio
takeaways.desc: Master 4:1 and 8:1 lighting ratios to convey depth and premium editorial aesthetic.

takeaways.title: Diffusion Mastery
takeaways.desc: Soften harsh LED emitters using 1/2 grid cloth for natural skin tones.

lessons.title: Camera Rigging, Lenses & Sensor Exposure
overview: Expose log footage (S-Log3, C-Log, V-Log) using false color and waveform monitors rather than subjective EVF.
Choose between spherical and anamorphic lens characteristics for specific brand aesthetics.

takeaways.title: False Color Calibration
takeaways.desc: Pin Caucasian skin tones to 60-70 IRE and South Asian tones to 50-60 IRE in Log.

takeaways.title: Shutter Angle Rule
takeaways.desc: Maintain 180-degree shutter angle (1/50s for 24fps) for cinematic motion blur.

lessons.title: J-Cuts, L-Cuts & Rhythmic Editing in Premiere
overview: Pace dialogue cuts according to musical rhythm and speaker emotional shifts.
Assemble rough assemblies into razor-sharp final agency edits.

takeaways.title: Audio Overlaps
takeaways.desc: Introduce ambient audio before visual transitions to disguise cut points.

takeaways.title: Micro-Trim Discipline
takeaways.desc: Eliminate empty frames and filler breathing pauses to maximize viewer retention.

lessons.title: DaVinci Resolve Node-Based Color Grading
overview: Balance primary exposure, normalize contrast curves, and build stylized show-LUTs using ACES color management.
Isolate skin tones using qualified Hue vs Hue and Hue vs Sat vectors.

takeaways.title: Color Space Transforms
takeaways.desc: Convert camera-native Log into Rec.709 with mathematical precision.

takeaways.title: Skin Tone Vector
takeaways.desc: Keep skin tones aligned strictly with the I-line on vectorscope.

lessons.title: Dialogue Cleanup, Foley & Audio Layering
overview: Clean noisy boom mic recordings with spectral de-noise and parametric dynamic equalization.
Layer ambient room tone, foley texture, and sub-bass risers for commercial impact.

takeaways.title: Dialogue Compression
takeaways.desc: Tame dialogue peaks with 3:1 opto-style compression and fast lookahead limiters.

takeaways.title: LUFS Broadcast Standards
takeaways.desc: Master audio to -14 LUFS for YouTube/Spotify and -16 LUFS for Apple Podcasts.

lessons.title: Export Profiles, Master Codecs & Client Handoff
overview: Export high-bitrate ProRes 422 HQ archival masters and web-optimized H.264/H.265 files.
Deliver project packages with clean timeline markers and consolidated source media.

takeaways.title: Master Archival
takeaways.desc: Preserve 10-bit color depth with uncompressed 48kHz 24-bit audio stems.

takeaways.title: Clean Project Handoff
takeaways.desc: Organize bins with standardized numbered prefixes for agency handoff.
